summary.text: Carol Glanville is a Democratic state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 84 and the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former educator and district administrator, she is not seeking re-election to the House.

paragraphs.text: Carol Glanville earned a B.A. from Western Michigan University in 1992 and an M.A. in curriculum and technology from the University of Phoenix in 2008.

Her career experience includes owning Carol Glanville Consulting and Contemporary Education Solutions, working as a program manager with the Dorothy A. Johnson Center for Philanthropy, and serving as an adjunct faculty member with Aquinas College.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she was a classroom teacher and a district administrator in educational technology.
Glanville said in the survey that she was appointed to the Walker City Commission in 2019 and kept the seat in the 2020 election.
She said she won a spring 2022 race for the state House and then won House District 84 in November 2022 and 2024.
She said she has served on the House Appropriations Committee and chaired the Higher Education Committee.
Glanville listed the cost of living and housing affordability, health care access and educational opportunities as her Senate priorities.
